aboutPage.title: Company
aboutPage.p1: At Enerva Elektrik, we have been providing electrical engineering, contracting, and project design services for more than a quarter of a century.
aboutPage.p2: Since our establishment, we have combined technology with engineering expertise to deliver major projects ranging from industrial facilities and commercial buildings to power transmission lines and infrastructure. Our innovative and solution-oriented approach has made us a symbol of trust in the industry.
aboutPage.p3: Our expert engineering team closely follows evolving technology and applies the latest standards and innovative solutions to your projects. Advanced software and equipment enable us to deliver precise designs and installations.
aboutPage.p4: We combine the best materials with skilled workmanship to build durable, safe, and long-lasting systems. Delivering projects on time without compromising occupational safety is our fundamental principle.
aboutPage.p5: By designing projects that maximize energy efficiency, we reduce operating costs while helping protect nature and build a sustainable future.
aboutPage.p6: Enerva Elektrik builds strong infrastructure for a brighter future.

og.title: Medium Voltage Systems
og.desc: Professional medium-voltage solutions for safe and uninterrupted power transmission.
og.detail: We design and deliver turnkey medium-voltage facilities tailored to your power needs. Our engineers handle transformer maintenance, switchgear installation and testing.

yeralti.title: Underground Cable Channels
yeralti.desc: Safe underground infrastructure for power and communications cables.
yeralti.detail: We excavate and install cable channels, conduits, cable runs and manholes for urban and on-site power distribution. Our work follows applicable standards and protects the surrounding environment.

salt.title: Switchyards
salt.desc: Design, installation and commissioning of indoor and outdoor switchyards.
salt.detail: For outdoor and enclosed AIS/GIS switchyards, we manage every stage from steel structure installation to circuit breakers, disconnectors, instrument transformers and secondary protection relay panels.

enerji.title: Power Transmission Lines
enerji.desc: Design and construction of underground and overhead lines, including pole installation and conductor stringing.
enerji.detail: We build medium- and high-voltage transmission lines to technical specifications, from foundations for galvanized polygonal, concrete or lattice poles through pole erection, insulator installation and conductor stringing.

proje.title: Electrical Project Design
proje.desc: Electrical installation and distribution design, including official approvals.
proje.detail: We prepare low- and high-voltage facility, lighting, power, low-current and automation plans in line with current TEDAŞ and EMO requirements. We perform the engineering calculations and follow the approval process on your behalf.
